description: “Hi, I’m Paul—semi-retired but always hands-on. With over 35 years of experience as a fully qualified plumber, heating engineer, and electrician, I’ve spent my life designing and building kitchens, bathrooms, and bedrooms—while keeping a spanner in one hand and a multimeter in the other. On this channel, you’ll find real-world DIY, car and motorbike restoration, tool talk, and a shed-load of collected treasures from over the years. I’m not just fixing things—I’m sharing a lifetime of skills, stories, and know-how. Welcome to Retired but Wired.”

videos.title: Fiat x19 Buried in dust in a barn waiting for a second chance to give a great driving experience.
